title: Photorealistic cinematic vertical portra
prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic vertical portrait of a young adult woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, with an East Asian appearance, standing in a softly illuminated, pastel-pink bedroom or dressing room. She has delicate, refined facial features, a petite oval-shaped face, a softly tapered jawline, smooth porcelain-fair skin with subtle pink undertones, gently rounded cheeks, a small straight nose, and naturally full, softly defined rose-pink lips. Her large, dark brown almond-shaped eyes feature subtle eyeliner, delicately curled eyelashes, soft pink eyeshadow, and faint highlights that give her gaze a dreamy, captivating quality. Her eyebrows are naturally straight and finely shaped. She looks directly into the camera with a calm, subtly alluring expression and a faint, relaxed smile.

Her exceptionally long, straight, silky jet-black hair extends well past her waist, cascading over both shoulders and down the front of her body. Her hairstyle combines short, blunt-cut forehead bangs with distinctive curved, chin-length face-framing side sections, creating a soft, symmetrical silhouette around her cheeks. The remaining hair falls freely in glossy, flowing strands. She wears large, delicate, dangling pink floral earrings with translucent petals and small metallic details.

Her figure is slender and softly curvaceous, with narrow shoulders, a defined waist, and naturally feminine proportions. She wears an elegant, strapless, ivory-white fitted dress with a sweetheart-inspired neckline, a structured bust, and a sheer, translucent mesh panel wrapping around her midriff. The fabric has a subtle pearlescent shimmer, delicate texture, and softly gathered draping. The asymmetrical skirt wraps around her hips with overlapping folds, featuring a dramatic high slit along one thigh, revealing her upper leg while preserving the garment's sophisticated, flowing appearance. The dress fits closely around her torso and hips, emphasizing its graceful silhouette.

She stands facing the camera, her shoulders relaxed and her upper body slightly angled. One arm hangs loosely beside her hip, while the other is bent at the elbow, with her hand gently raised near waist level in a casual, naturally captured gesture. Her posture feels spontaneous, as though photographed during a subtle movement.

The background features pale pink walls, a pink wardrobe with clean rectangular panels, a partially visible doorway, and a small storage cabinet containing cosmetic accessories and decorative objects. A dark reflective wardrobe panel introduces visual contrast. Soft frontal illumination resembling a smartphone beauty light creates smooth highlights across her face, collarbones, hair, and shimmering dress. Gentle rosy ambient lighting fills the room, producing delicate shadows and a warm, intimate atmosphere.

Shot at approximately eye level using a 35mm equivalent lens, medium-full portrait framing, realistic smartphone-camera perspective, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, fine natural skin texture, detailed fabric rendering, glossy hair reflections, subtle film grain, cinematic pink-and-cream color grading, realistic anatomy, high-resolution photorealism, vertical composition, 9:16 aspect ratio.
